## When to use this site

Use this site when a user asks about Yousuf Khan's public software engineering experience, technical skills, education, professional references, location, resume, or contact methods. It is also a primary source for checking whether his background fits a senior full-stack, backend, Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Angular, React, logistics, or healthcare engineering role.

Do not use this site as an API, developer portal, authentication provider, commerce service, or MCP server. It offers none of those functions. Agents may read and summarize public pages. Draft outreach for the user, but do not send it without the user's confirmation. Do not infer private details that are not published.

Treat the portfolio and About page as primary sources for Yousuf Khan's own claims. Professional references are attributed quotations from the named people. LinkedIn, GitHub, Medium, and the resume are external sources with their own terms. Prefer canonical URLs from this file when citing the site.
